verdict.rationale: Marqeta's own docs describe Gateway JIT funding, where the customer's system receives each funding request at transaction time and approves or denies it under its own business rules. That covers the just-in-time half of the story. There is no explicit evidence of a selectable prefunded-balance model and nothing documenting cash-flow tradeoffs between the two. missing for 10: documented prefunded/program-funding option, documentation comparing cash-flow tradeoffs of prefunded vs JIT, independent corroboration.
